There's this saying back when I was doing Private Equity that

"Investment is like marriage"

That was certainly true in PE where an investment could last years and as an investor you're essentially required to support your portcos as much as you can

What's interesting is that crypto is starting to feel like marriage

Crypto used to feel like one night stand - a one and done kinda experience where you get in fast, get out fast, and then rotate onto the next trade

Now it's the other way around, "onchain businesses" are treating token holders like equity holders. And because of that, the onchain businesses are starting to be treated, valued, and priced like actual businesses. Onchain exchanges, inference platforms, yield venues, lending marketplaces 

While valuation multiples remain compressed, it's starting to make sense to value these "companies" based on their growth trajectory, based on their growth as a business and not on how hyped they can make it to be.

It feels like the bride and the groom are aligned and on the same page instead of one wanting to extract from the other as fast as possible

Pretty bullish
